name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Nadia and the player who loves the Fork are in different camps.

Discovery goes with at least one of Judit, Nadia, or Pirc.
The Slav player and Nadia are in different study groups.
Vera belongs to the Morning Study Group.
Caro-Kann goes with none of Vera, Discovery, or Skewer.
